benchmark_entry.name: Smile no-arbitrage: Roper's theorem, the left wing, calendar spreads, one Black form
benchmark_entry.description: A raw SVI smile with positive variance whose smiled call is a normalised call price function has left wing slope b(1 - rho) at most 2.

code.lean:
import MathFin.Models.ModelFree.LeftWingBound

open MathFin
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped NNReal ENNReal

/-- A raw SVI smile with positive variance whose smiled call is a normalised call price function has left wing slope b(1 - rho) at most 2. -/
theorem mf_svi_left_wing_bound (p : SVI.Params)
    (hpos : ∀ k : ℝ, 0 < SVI.variance p k)
    (hC : IsNormalizedCallPrice (SVI.bsSmile p)) :
    p.b * (1 - p.rho) ≤ 2 :=
  MathFin.svi_left_wing_slope_le_two p hpos hC
